device.name: Rohde & Schwarz HMP4040 four-channel power supply

facts.text: The project sequences the power supply of an electronic board and controls R&S HMP40xx/20xx supplies over SCPI
The upstream README warns that its software protections do not replace a hardware safety device nor the operator's judgement
HMP4040 is the SCPI driver for the Rohde & Schwarz HMP4040 through pyvisa
HMP4030 and HMP2030 declare three channels, and HMP2020 declares two channels
connect() opens the VISA resource with pyvisa and probes *IDN?
connect() sends *CLS, switches every channel output off with OUTP:SEL OFF and then enables the general output with OUTP:GEN ON
A setting selects the channel with INST OUT<n> and then writes VOLT, CURR or OUTP:SEL
A measurement selects the channel and queries MEAS:VOLT? or MEAS:CURR?
When status reading is enabled, measure_status queries STAT:QUES:INST:ISUM<channel>:COND? and decodes CC/CV/OTP/OVP/FUSE bits; a disabled or failed status query returns mode=None and no faults
all_outputs_off() calls set_output(ch, False) for every channel
close() attempts all_outputs_off with a shortened timeout and use_opc=False, suppresses its failure, then closes the VISA session
_write sends a command and optionally queries *OPC? without inspecting its reply
_select caches a channel number, and setting voltage, current or output selects a channel before writing its command; those methods contain no lock
The HMP4040 declares max_voltage = 32.0 V, max_current = 10.0 A and max_power = 160.0 W per channel
The config validator rejects a channel max_voltage above the model's max_voltage and a max_current above max_current, but does not combine them into a power bound
The controller's emergency_stop() takes each instrument lock non-blocking and still calls all_outputs_off() when the lock is busy
The upstream factory builds MockPSU when simulate is true and the model class otherwise
